CD74ACT283E.note: Maximum includes 4.5 V and -55..125 C at 50 pF. All modeled contamination delays are zero. Datasheet pin-function table has VCC=14 typo; package drawing and legacy symbol correctly use pin 16.

conditions: 4.5 V logic bounds at 50 pF encompassing 0..50 C. Actual slew, reset, supply, connectors and shared DATA capacitance remain unqualified.
scope: PH1 operand snapshots isolate PH3 updates from feedback. SP1 synchronous add/subtract and byte loads; MA1 early snapshot-address bypass with PH3 retained address, increment and byte loads. Dedicated continuously driven PC and stack address links replace the shared-address assumption for this integration.
